items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: "Be careful, Vern, or we'll get throwed off this lot."

ctx.x: No! [LAUGHS] "I'll have them throw you off the lot." Scaring these people and every other thing, you know. And you could see these poor country people, [WHISPERING], "Listen to that," or "Be careful, Vern, or we'll get throwed off this lot."
They wanted to see the show, huh?
